build.buildCommand: php /usr/local/bin/composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction && npm ci && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: php artisan migrate --force && (php artisan storage:link || true) && php artisan config:clear && php artisan route:clear && php artisan view:clear && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT
